head.subject: observer: CONTINUE - popsign fresh5 fit readiness handoff

changed_files.change_summary: Records the no-training M3DB readiness review, scaffold evidence, fit-prompt blocker, carried-forward gates, and exactly one selected next action.

reviewer_inference: The M3DA scaffold evidence is strong enough for a no-training scaffold-readiness claim: the model instantiates, preserves the intended input shapes, exposes useful diagnostic tensors, fits the parameter and retained-diagnostic budgets, and leaves browser claims fail-closed.

The M3DA scaffold evidence is not enough to authorize a future bounded local fit prompt today because the current PopSign fresh5 training smoke command surface cannot invoke the new architecture and cannot target a fresh ignored output directory.
Drafting a fit prompt anyway would create a command envelope that is known to fail before fitting, or would require reusing old output directories that are already bound to prior evidence.

The next useful executor slice should stay no-training and complete the bounded readiness/invocation gap before any fitting command is authorized; this review does not take an observer-only redirect decision or invent an unlisted next action.

exact_blockers.evidence: The current PopSign fresh5 training smoke guard requires --architecture scratch_region_temporal_late_fusion_tcn_contract_v1; a dry-run with scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 exits 2 before any fitting.

The current PopSign fresh5 training smoke output allowlist accepts only the M3CF and M3CR output directories; a dry-run with output/m3dc-popsign-fresh5-scratch-motion-region-token-temporal-local-fit exits 2 before any fitting.

expected_artifacts_for_any_later_fit_aft: a tracked validation receipt summarizing command, artifact hashes, metric gates, collapse gates, and fail-closed browser proof

required_stop_gates_for_any_future_fit: Stop before fitting if no-training dry-run/check-files cannot invoke scratch_motion_region_token_temporal_contract_v1 through the PopSign fresh5 repaired-manifest path.
Stop before fitting if the output directory is not a fresh ignored output/ path dedicated to the new scaffold fit.
Stop after the first future local fit if validation top-1 remains 0.20, macro F1 remains 0.06666666666666668, and predictions remain single-class collapsed.

Stop after the first future local fit if train representation diagnostics remain at or below the M3CV neighborhood: head_input between/within ratio about 0.3368962860376266 and nearest-centroid accuracy about 0.176.

Stop if the path requires pretrained dependencies, source/register mutation, manifest mutation, tensor regeneration, label/vocabulary mutation, source expansion, generated labels, Brev, export, browser activation, model-card promotion, final-gate weakening, unsupported claims, or product recognition claims.

decision.reason: The scaffold passes no-training shape, diagnostic, parameter, memory, and fail-closed checks, but the current PopSign fresh5 training smoke invocation surface rejects the new scaffold architecture and rejects a fresh output directory before any fitting can start.
decision.next_action_rationale: Within the allowed M3DB next-action list, this is the only option that honestly records a blocked readiness review without authorizing fitting, Brev, implementation, source/data/tensor mutation, export, promotion, claim changes, or an observer-only redirect.
